headline: Stop Bing sends to DEAD families; focus on /backtest and fix ChatGPT losses

findings.claim: 87% of Bing sends go to WEAK/DEAD families that produce almost no accounts
findings.so: Stop sending Bing traffic to WEAK/DEAD families and focus on WIN families only

findings.claim: /backtest and /backtest-<market> families are WIN and bring most accounts but have leaks losing 14.9 and 6.8 people respectively
findings.so: Focus effort on improving conversion on /backtest and /backtest-<market> pages

findings.claim: AI accounts per week dropped from 34 to 16, showing hooks machine is losing effectiveness
findings.so: Fix or pause hooks machine until it learns from outcomes and improves AI account yield

findings.claim: Pages in DEAD families like /news/<release> and /economic-calendar/<x> have 0 accounts despite thousands of pages and reads
findings.so: No new pages or effort on DEAD families; keep them Google noindexed as done

findings.claim: ChatGPT source lost peak clicks from 162 to 44 and /backtest clicks from 126 to 4, causing −67 and −59 accounts/week losses
findings.so: Investigate and restore what worked on ChatGPT source and /backtest pages around 2026-10-25 peak

knobs.why: Champion is 0.15 but challenger 0.2 is being tested; more exploration may find better Bing send targets than current WEAK/DEAD families
